newsitem.title: USA: Wolverine says to shift production of goods.
newsitem.headline: Wolverine says to shift production of goods.

text.p: Wolverine Tube Inc said it would shift its manufacturing to lower margin products amid weak demand for its products used in commercial and residential air conditioners.

The company said the weak demand stemmed from a slowed rate of replacing large air conditioners using refrigerants, as well as higher investories of manufacturer and distributor residential air conditioners.

If current market conditions persisted throughout the third quarter, the company said it could see a decrease in fabrication charges -- sales prices less metal -- of 15 to 18 percent, compared with the third quarter of 1996.
Officials from the company were not immediately available to comment.
